core_counts.5_existing_split: No fixed directory split. All 50 clips exist in raw class folders (Data/Lame, Data/Normal).

file_and_annotation_specs.11_label_granularity: Per-video / per-clip level. No per-frame bounding boxes or gait keypoint coordinates.

identity_and_leakage_assessment.12_details: Individual cattle IDs are not provided in the filenames, CSVs, or folder structure.
identity_and_leakage_assessment.13_details: Original paper README documents 50 video clips featuring 42 individual cattle. By pigeonhole principle, at least 8 clips share cattle identities with other clips.
identity_and_leakage_assessment.14_cow_across_proposed_splits_risk: High under naive random video splitting. Without explicit cow IDs, random splitting risks placing the same cow in both train and test splits.

15_duplicate_or_near_duplicate_videos.note: All 50 clips represent distinct video cuts or different sequences.

identity_and_leakage_assessment.16_frame_leakage_across_splits_risk: Preventable if splitting is done strictly at the VIDEO level (entire video in train or val/test). If frames were shuffled independently, catastrophic leakage would occur.
identity_and_leakage_assessment.19_identifiability_limitation: CRITICAL LIMITATION: Specific cow-to-video mapping is not provided by dataset authors. Animal identity cannot be deterministically separated at split time, posing a mild identity-leakage risk of ~8 clips.
20_unusual_characteristics: All videos are pre-cropped to square 500x500 pixels.
Variable framerate spanning 25 fps to 60 fps (YouTube Shorts vs standard YouTube uploads).
Variable durations (1.35s to 12.28s) require uniform temporal sampling (e.g. fixed 16 frames uniformly sampled along timeline).
Heterogeneous backgrounds: indoor milking parlors/concrete chutes and outdoor grass/mud pastures.
Diverse camera angles: lateral (side-view), oblique, and semi-frontal.
